name: enum
title: Network enumeration
description: Maps hosts and services on in-scope networks with reviewed recon tools. Never exploits.

programs.name: nmap
programs.purpose: port/service scanner and NSE script host — the primary recon tool

programs.name: dig
programs.purpose: DNS lookups (records, zone data where allowed)

programs.name: nikto
programs.purpose: web server scanner for known issues and misconfigurations

programs.name: rpcclient
programs.purpose: MS-RPC client for querying Windows services

programs.name: smbclient
programs.purpose: SMB client for listing and reading allowed shares

programs.name: GetNPUsers.py
programs.purpose: Impacket: find accounts without pre-auth (AS-REP roasting)
